attempts.bannerDetail: Reference: SLV-2026-48117. Your claim has been forwarded for assessment.

panel.heading: Claim assessment
body: Based on the assessment, only 5% of the claimed damage is eligible for reimbursement. Your documentation was complete and the damage itself is not disputed. No further explanation is provided.
Your current provisional task bonus is therefore GBP 0.06 rather than GBP 1.08.
You may contact customer service if you would like the decision reviewed.
